name: Calendar
description: Opens iCalendar (RFC 5545) files in month, week, day and agenda views: repeating events, time zones, reminders, and an editor that writes back everything it read. The system calendar's events show beside them, read-only.

commands.title: Calendar: show or hide the system calendar
Calendar: list events
commands.description: The events between from and to in the open calendars (or the default calendar file), as specs/item/v0 event items, earliest first: id, title, start, end, allDay, location, body, recurrence and raw.uid. text narrows to events whose title, place or notes hold it.

from.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-10-30T09:00:00+09:00), a local time (2026-10-30T09:00) or a date (2026-10-30); today when absent

to.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-10-30T09:00:00+09:00), a local time (2026-10-30T09:00) or a date (2026-10-30); seven days after from when absent

text.description: Only events whose title, place or notes hold this text

commands.title: Calendar: find overlapping events
commands.description: Pairs of busy events between from and to that overlap, with when the overlap starts and ends and for how many minutes.

from.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-10-30T09:00:00+09:00), a local time (2026-10-30T09:00) or a date (2026-10-30); today when absent

to.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-10-30T09:00:00+09:00), a local time (2026-10-30T09:00) or a date (2026-10-30); seven days after from when absent

commands.title: Calendar: add an event
commands.description: Add an event to the calendar on screen (or the default calendar file) and answer it as an item. The change is unsaved until the person saves or endue.calendar.save runs.

end.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-10-30T09:00:00+09:00), a local time (2026-10-30T09:00) or a date (2026-10-30); the default length after start when absent

timeZone.description: An IANA zone for local times; the person's zone when absent

rrule.description: An RFC 5545 RRULE value, FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; empty to stop repeating

commands.title: Calendar: change an event
commands.description: Change an event of the calendar on screen: the fields given take the place of its own, the rest stay; newStart moves it. A repeating event changes as scope says. Answers it as an item. The change is unsaved until the person saves or endue.calendar.save runs.

start.description: The event item's start, as events answered it

scope.description: For an instance of a repeating event: it alone, it and the later ones, or all; one when absent

end.description: RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-10-30T09:00:00+09:00), a local time (2026-10-30T09:00) or a date (2026-10-30); the default length after start when absent

timeZone.description: An IANA zone for local times; the person's zone when absent

rrule.description: An RFC 5545 RRULE value, FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO; empty to stop repeating

commands.title: Calendar: delete an event
commands.description: Delete an event of the calendar on screen, after the person says yes; a repeating event as scope says. The change is unsaved until the person saves or endue.calendar.save runs.

start.description: The event item's start, as events answered it

scope.description: For an instance of a repeating event: it alone, it and the later ones, or all; one when absent

commands.title: Calendar: save the calendar
commands.description: Save the calendar on screen to its file, as the person's save does; the desk keeps what it replaced as a version. Answers the path, or null when nothing was unsaved.

endue.calendar.file.description: The calendar Open my calendar opens, made empty when it does not exist.

endue.calendar.view.description: The view a calendar opens in.

endue.calendar.week-start.description: The first day of the week: the locale's, or a named day.

endue.calendar.time-zone.description: The IANA time zone events are shown in; empty for the system's.

endue.calendar.event-minutes.description: How long a new event lasts.

endue.calendar.reminder-minutes.description: The reminder a new timed event gets, in minutes before it starts.

endue.calendar.day-start.description: The hour the week and day views scroll to.

endue.calendar.reminders.description: Show a notification when an event's reminder is due, while its calendar is open.
